summary: Cadeler A/S, a Danish offshore wind installation company listed on NYSE (CDLR) and Oslo Børs (CADLR), filed a Form 6-K furnishing a stock exchange announcement revising upward its FY2026 guidance. Revenue is now guided to EUR 910-1,000 million (from EUR 854-944 million) and EBITDA to EUR 435-525 million (from EUR 420-510 million), excluding Menck acquisition and integration costs. The update reflects the completed acquisition of Menck on 11 August 2026 and an anticipated December 2026 hammer sale. This is a routine guidance update, not a standalone special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed.
